# Bali Are Property

> Independent property agency in Bali, Indonesia, founded in 2009 by Bagoes. Sells land, villas, houses and commercial property, mainly in South Kuta (Ungasan, Jimbaran, Pecatu/Uluwatu, Kutuh/Pandawa, Balangan) and North Kuta (Canggu, Berawa, Pererenan, Tibubeneng, Kerobokan), plus Kuta, Ubud, Gianyar and Tabanan. Prices in Indonesian rupiah (IDR); titles are mostly SHM (freehold certificate). Contact: WhatsApp +62 812 868 080, https://baliareproperty.com/. Site languages: Indonesian (default), English (/en/), Russian (/ru/).
